content: The continuing opening paragraph calls compatibility an important extra relation on M alongside the two order relations. It says, “Moralement”, that these relations recover “l’atelier” up to unique isomorphism, qualified in the margin by “au moins dans le cas modéré”.

The page proposes F parallel G for disjunction, and a vertically divided diamond or an opposed-zigzag sign for compatibility. The latter whole expression is circled. A note compares speed of writing and suggestiveness of the signs.

The lower paragraph introduces the live preccurlyeq relation “de raffinement”, says it is “formellement de nature plus délicate” and “la notion la plus spécifique” in the “Algèbre des figures”, then begins a sentence about geometric meaning, examples and axioms which continues past this page.
math_reading_decisions: The source, not the apparent compatibility with neighboring conventions, decides the word raffinement. H’s editorial comparison with another page was not independently consulted or used to correct this page.
The centered relation labels are preserved as undersets. The plain variable F/G forms are kept separate from the special family F alphabet.
The live compatibility alternative has open upper and lower tips; it is not a closed hourglass. The NB extra sign has uncertain live/canceled state, printed as state alternatives.
No closing parenthesis for the opening “(NB” is visible before the paragraph’s period; none is supplied. No unseen continuation text is supplied after ceux-.
author_doubts: “au moins dans le cas modéré” qualifies the reconstruction claim.
“On n’a rien dit pour l’instant au sujet de la relation …” identifies a topic not yet discussed; it is not an explicit proof-check instruction.
No “à vérifier”, “sauf erreur”, question mark on an argument, or other explicit verification demand appears on this page.
titles_dates_counts: Manuscript number 9 at the top center; scan 010 in the packet.
Quoted title/name: “Algèbre des figures”, with raised paired strokes rather than guillemets.
No date, total page count, archive pencil sheet number, independent diagram or additional footer observed.
